## 2. Core Technical Architecture (ABI v4)
- Language & Purity: Freestanding ISO C23 (`-ffreestanding`, `-fno-strict-aliasing`, `-Werror=stack-usage=2048`), zero libc, zero heap, zero floating-point operations in `core/`, zero writable globals (`core_obj_gate`), zero unaligned AVX stack spills (`avx_stack_gate`).
- Modules: 22 selectable domain modules (`rng`, `fx`, `grid`, `scan`, `sense`, `brain`, `genome`, `social`, `mate`, `econ`, `metab`, `physics`, `life`, `field`, `chem`, `weather`, `colony`, `tier1`, `stats`, `worldgen`, `ledger`, `snapshot`) + 5 core runtime files (`az_world.c`, `az_tick.c`, `az_store.c`, `az_kin_axis.c`, `az_rock_place.c`) + 4 pure-integer kernels (`tk_sh`, `tk_hop`, `tk_qgt`, `tk_qsv`).
- ABI Dimensions (`core/az_abi.h`): `AZ_ABI_VERSION=4`, `AZ_SENS=64`, `AZ_MOT=24`, `AZ_MODG=8`, `AZ_TRAITS=112`, `AZ_PHEN=16`, `AZ_UNIT=64`, `AZ_CHUNK=128`, `AZ_LESION_ALL=0x7FFFFF` (23 named bits), `AZ_CAP_MAX=0x7FFFFFC0`, `WG_MAX_SPECIES=100`.
- Memory Model: Single pre-allocated Windows `VirtualLock` page-locked arena, 128-entity SoA blocks, two-half 64B-granule compacting creature store, zero pagefile/NVMe swap.
- Exact Conservation (Law 5): `AZ_EPS_NUT_X=24`, `AZ_EPS_BIO=16`, `AZ_EPS_TOXIN=4`, `AZ_EPS_WASTE=2`; global matter and energy hold with `==` after every tick; `field_underflow == 0`; `dropped_events == 0`.
- Modes (Law 6): Wild by default (`BCryptGenRandom` every tick); `--lab --seed S` deterministic counter-based Philox4x32-10 with canonical UID order.
- Hardware Twins: 4 NASM x86-64 AVX2/AVX-VNNI twins (`az_brain_vnni.asm`, `az_dense_vnni.asm`, `az_philox_avx2.asm`, `az_kin_avx2.asm`) + Clang 21 `nvptx64` pure-integer PTX (`41,817 B`, 0 externs, 0 floats, `az_gpu_k_tile_brain`, `az_gpu_k_kin_axis`, `az_gpu_k_philox`, `az_gpu_k_brain`).

## 3. Verified Empirical Results
- CTest: `77/77` PASS (including `ubsan_trap_build` with 6 planted UB traps, `core_obj_gate`, `avx_stack_gate`, `lint_core`, `cli_matrix_engine`, `cli_matrix_protocol`, `cli_gpu_tick_parity`, `test_gpu`).
- GPU Differential Suite (`test_gpu.exe`): `164/164` PASS on RTX 5070 Ti (compute 12.0, 12,199 MiB, CUDA driver API 13040): 1,000,000 variable-size sparse `AzBrain` steps `hid=0 motor=0`; 1,000,000 kinematics lanes `0` diffs; 1-word bias-mutation negative control differs on `806/4096` creatures.
- Live 1k 3-Substrate Parity (`--lab --seed 42 --n 1000 --ticks 10`): `--kernels 0`, `--kernels 1`, and `--kernels 1 --gpu 1` all yield identical hash `7bd9823448dd38b1`, exact matter `742819 -> 742819`, exact energy `9724070 -> 9724070`.
- Bare-Metal Benchmarks (Core Ultra 9 275HX 8P+16E + RTX 5070 Ti, `--lab --seed 42`, `locked=1`):
  - 10k (`21e4cfcdf0b08066`): bit-exact parity across C-ref, VNNI, GPU.
  - 100k (`5b8110b324d2603f`, 153,084 live): 8P C-ref `113.162 ms/tick`, 8P VNNI+Philox `109.323 ms/tick`, RTX 5070 Ti+24C `92.801 ms/tick`, 24C P+E VNNI+Philox+PF `72.199 ms/tick` (`+56.7%`).
  - 1M (`31e5d00c106ce679`, 1,004,019 live, `9,260.6 MB` locked): 8P C-ref `1,025.332 ms/tick`, 8P VNNI+PF `976.322 ms/tick`, 24C P+E VNNI+PF `757.988 ms/tick` (`+35.3%`), RTX 5070 Ti+24C `1,122.495 ms/tick` (slower due to PCIe compaction overhead; disclosed honestly).
  - HyperBrain 96-neuron parity: hash `73a8d1f51b9556da`.
  - Refusal boundary: `--species 101` exits 2 before arena allocation.
  - Windows `--large-pages`: falls back cleanly to 4 KiB `VirtualLock` (`large_pages=0`) absent `SeLockMemoryPrivilege` (`TR-03`).

## 4. Machine-Checked Formal Proofs (`lean/`, Lean 4.35.0)
- 30 Pure Lean 4.35.0 theorems (`A01`..`A30`), zero Mathlib, zero `sorry` in `Solution`, zero `native_decide`, `autoImplicit = false`, `relaxedAutoImplicit = false`.
- Palomar module layout: `Spec.lean` (pure defs), `Core.lean` (`A01`..`A26`), `NonVacuity.lean` (`A27`..`A30`: concrete witnesses + adversarial false-variant refutations), `Challenge.lean` (statement-only `sorry`), `Solution.lean`, `VerifyAxioms.lean`, `comparator.json`, `formalization.yaml`.
- Strict axiom footprint: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` only; 0 forbidden axioms.
- Local Windows 5-kernel verification: `lean4`, `leanchecker --fresh`, `leanchecker-paranoid --fresh`, `con-leche --verified` (1,778 decls), `con-ron --verified` (1,778 decls), `nanoda_bin` (1,987 decls, `unpermitted_axiom_hard_error: true`). All 6/6 kernels including `lean4lean` + `bubblewrap` comparator run in Linux CI.

## 5. Non-Negotiable Honesty & Scope Boundaries
- Law 8: Indicator-only. Zero claims of consciousness, sentience, biological life, AGI, or quantum speedup.
- Mega-Atlas: `0 / 1,900` overarching open problems retired (`AI-045`, `BIO-001`, `BIO-008`, `SUB-047`, `SYS-050` remain OPEN).
- Law 14: Every edited text file must be pure 7-bit ASCII, LF line endings, zero tabs (except `.tsv`), trailing newline (`python -I build/work/scripts/check_text.py .`).
- Never delete owner files (`docs/eval/TRACE.csv`, 4,977,947 B).
